name: autonomous-engineering-platform
description: Repository tooling for the Autonomous Engineering Platform

scripts.dev: nodemon --exitcrash --signal SIGTERM --watch aep/src/Aep --ext cs,csproj,json --ignore "aep/src/Aep/bin/**" --ignore "aep/src/Aep/obj/**" --exec "dotenv -e .env -- dotnet run --project aep/src/Aep/Aep.csproj"
scripts.db:migrate: npm run db:up && cd aep && dotenv -e ../.env -- dotnet ef database update --project src/Aep/Aep.csproj --startup-project src/Aep/Aep.csproj
scripts.start: npm run db:up && dotenv -e .env -- concurrently --kill-others --names "AEP,Jira Simulator,Jira MCP" "npm run dev" "npm run start --prefix mcp/jira-simulator" "npm run dev --prefix mcp/jira-simulator-mcp-server"
